\label{nablaconv}

For every $t<0$,
\[
 |\nabla^{h_k}l_k|_{h_k}^2d\vol(h_k)
 \longrightarrow |\nabla l_\infty|_{g_\infty}^2d\vol(g_\infty)
\]
in the distributional sense on $M_\infty\times\{t\}$.
\end{lemma}
